$comment: The ingestion: every field we can hand a decision model, and where it comes from. Addresses are the port's own (runtime/roam_game.c); a field whose source is 'memory' is read directly, one whose source is 'frame' comes from a captured screenshot.

speed_kmh.note: signed forward speed, absolute value taken

traffic.note: every car in the world: the node is the car, next at +0, and each carries its driver type at +0x24 (1 the player, 3 an AI racer, 4 traffic, 0 a friend). Read relative to our own car: distance, metres ahead along our travel, metres to the right, their speed, and the closing speed along the line of sight. Documentation/Memory.md has the walk and the struct.

flow.note: GameFlowManager state: 3 front end, 6 in the world

career_race.note: the career race being run; 0 is free roam

route_cue_x.note: the route arrow's screen x, 0.5 centred; null when it is not on screen

route_cue_pixels.note: cluster size, a proxy for how sure the detection is

road_band_motion.note: mean absolute difference of the bottom strip between frames: parked 0.5-0.8, driving 14-32

derived.moved_m: metres the car actually advanced over the last 6 ticks, from the position delta - not from the wheel speed
derived.turned_degrees: heading change over the same window, wrapped to a half turn
derived.blocked_ticks: consecutive ticks with the throttle held and the window's metres under 1.5
derived.verdict: one of moving, creeping, blocked, stalled - what the rules branch on
derived.situation: the verdict in words, sent beside the numbers: the model is told what the numbers mean, not left to infer it
derived.stuck: blocked_ticks >= 3 or 3 consecutive ticks under 2 km/h - speed alone cannot say it, because a car held against a wall still reports its wheel speed
derived.slipping: any slip value above 5 on a road surface
